## 1. Executive Summary & Design Philosophy

### 1.1 What is ReceiptLedger?
ReceiptLedger is an everyday receipt-scanning and spending tracker. People photograph physical paper receipts from grocery stores, local marts, pharmacies, cafes, and bakeries. The app reads the receipt, pulls out individual line items, quantities, and prices, categorizes them, and tracks where money is going.

### 1.2 What We Mean by "Warmth"
> [!NOTE]
> **Important Clarification on "Warmth":**  
> When we say "warm", we do **not** mean yellow, beige, or muddy brown tones!  
> **"Warm" means human, approachable, friendly, forgiving, and effortless to use.**  
> It means zero friction, clear buttons, forgiving error messages, and a design that feels like a trusted personal pocket notebook rather than an intimidating corporate banking app or a cold tax accounting spreadsheet.

### 1.3 The Two Golden Visual Rules (Strict Hard Constraints)
1. **Rule #1: ZERO GRADIENTS.**  
   Do not use rainbow gradients, color fades, multi-stop backdrops, or shiny button gradients. Everything must use solid, confident, flat colors with deliberate contrast.
2. **Rule #2: ZERO LIQUID GLASS / GLASSMORPHISM.**  
   Do not use frosted acrylic blur, translucent floating glass cards, or glossy liquid highlights. Use clean flat surfaces, crisp 1px to 1.5px outlines, solid cards, and crisp pill shapes.

---

## 2. Deliverable #1: App Icon & Brand Logo (Highest Priority)

The application icon is the first thing a user sees on their homescreen every day. It must be unique, memorable, and reusable across the app.

### 2.1 Personality & Requirements
* **Casual, Playful & Fun:** It should feel friendly and casual—not like a dry government tax audit or a stiff calculator.
* **Relevant Motif:** Incorporate subtle receipt or paper slip cues (e.g. a folded receipt slip, a receipt with a friendly smile notch, a smiling tally mark, or an origami-folded ledger slip).
* **Homescreen Impact:** Must stand out cleanly against both bright colorful wallpapers and dark wallpapers.
* **Formats Needed:**
  * Master 1024×1024 PNG (vector flat).
  * iOS squircle presentation.
  * Android adaptive icon (foreground icon + flat background).
  * In-app header brand mark (horizontal lockup: icon + "ReceiptLedger" clean wordmark).

---

## 3. Deliverable #2: Secret Tucked-Away Profile Sidebar (Drawer)

Instead of cluttering the bottom navigation bar with account/profile screens, we want a **sleek, functional sidebar drawer** that is tucked away out of sight and only opens when the user taps their **circular Profile Picture Avatar** in the top corner of the home screen.

### 3.1 Interaction & Header Anchor
* **Top App Bar:** Shows the clean ReceiptLedger logo on the left, and a circular user avatar on the right.
* **Gesture:** Tapping the avatar smoothly slides out a right-hand (or left-hand) sidebar drawer with a darkened backdrop.

### 3.2 Contents of the Sidebar Drawer
1. **User Profile Header:**
   * High-contrast circular avatar photo (with edit badge).
   * User full name (e.g., *"Asad Khan"*).
   * Email address (`user@receiptledger.com`).
   * Clean status tag: `Local Ledger` or `Sync Active`.
2. **Account & Preferences Menu:**
   * **Profile Settings:** Edit display name, change password, currency selector (PKR, USD, EUR, etc.).
   * **Data & Export:** Download monthly ledger as CSV/Excel, backup local receipts.
   * **Appearance (Theme Selector):** A clean 3-way flat pill switch for **Light / Dark / High-Contrast B&W**.
   * **About ReceiptLedger:** App version (v1.0.0), privacy statement, developer credits, licenses.
3. **Bottom Action:**
   * **Log Out Button:** Clean, distinct button with a subtle red accent outline/tint tucked at the very bottom of the drawer.

---

## 4. Current Barebones Application & What Needs Improvement

We have taken real screenshots of our current working Flutter prototype. It is barebones, plain, and needs a massive UI/UX overhaul. Below are the self-contained screenshots, honest critiques, and the redesign wishlists.

---

### Screen 1: Receipt Capture & Scan Screen

![Current Capture Screen](data:image/jpeg;base64,)  
*File location: `docs/assets/barebones_screenshots/02_capture_screen_barebones.jpg`*

#### Critique of Current Screen:
* The current screen has two tiny disconnected buttons ("Take Photo", "Gallery") floating at the top with an empty gray placeholder box in the middle.
* The "Upload & Process Receipt" button is an unappealing gray slab at the bottom.
* There is no sense of excitement, guidance, or indication of what kind of camera quality works best.

#### Redesign Wishlist:
* **Prominent Camera Viewfinder Card:** A large, inviting capture surface with corner guide marks showing how to frame a receipt.
* **Quick Toggle:** A minimal pill switch to flip between **Single Receipt** and **Batch Mode (Multiple Slips)**.
* **One-Tap Actions:** A prominent, tactile shutter button for camera capture, with a secondary clean button for gallery upload.
* **OCR Mode Pill:** A subtle badge showing the active engine: `Gemini AI Vision` (High Accuracy) or `Offline Fast OCR`.
* **Recent Scan Preview:** A small carousel or thumbnail card at the bottom showing the last receipt successfully snapped.

---

### Screen 2: Review Queue Screen (Human-in-the-Loop)

![Current Review Queue Screen](data:image/jpeg;base64,)  
*File location: `docs/assets/barebones_screenshots/04_review_queue_barebones.jpg`*

#### Critique of Current Screen:
* As seen in the screenshot, when an error occurs, it displays a terrifying technical message: `"TimeoutException after 0:00:10.000000: Future not completed"` in raw red text!
* When working, items are crammed into a generic list without context.

#### Redesign Wishlist:
* **Human-in-the-Loop Verification Card:**
  * **Visual Receipt Crop:** Top half of the card shows the actual cropped snippet of the physical receipt paper where the text was read from.
  * **Candidate Text Field:** Bottom half shows what the AI read: Item Name, Quantity, and Price.
  * **Confidence Level:** A clean colored pill indicator (e.g., `72% Confidence - Check Price`).
  * **One-Tap Buttons:**
    * Solid green `Confirm / Accept` button.
    * Crisp outlined `Quick Edit` button.
* **Friendly Empty State:** When all items are verified, show a delightful graphic: *"All caught up! Every receipt is verified."*
* **Friendly Error State:** If the backend times out, replace raw technical logs with a friendly card: *"Couldn't reach your server. Let's try that again"* with a simple `Retry Connection` button.

---

### Screen 3: Ledger & Spending History Screen

![Current Ledger Screen](data:image/jpeg;base64,)  
*File location: `docs/assets/barebones_screenshots/03_ledger_screen_barebones.jpg`*

#### Critique of Current Screen:
* The current screen only shows a blank page with a single spinning green circle.
* There is no month selector, no visual indication of categories, and no search functionality.

#### Redesign Wishlist:
* **Monthly Spending Summary Header:**
  * Big, legible total spend number (e.g., `Rs. 42,850`).
  * Month picker dropdown / chevron selector (`October 2026`).
  * Delta comparison tag: `"-12% vs last month"` in a subtle green pill.
* **Category Filter Chips:** Horizontal scrollable flat pills: `All`, `Groceries`, `Household`, `Pharmacy`, `Snacks`, `Utilities`.
* **Itemized Receipt Cards:**
  * Clean card showing Store Name (e.g., *Imtiaz Super Market*), Date (*12 Oct*), Item count (*8 items*), and Total (*Rs. 3,420*).
  * Category color dot next to each receipt.
  * Tapping expands the receipt to reveal line items.
* **Search Bar:** Minimal flat search input to instantly filter by item name (e.g., searching "flour" or "panadol").

---

### Screen 4: Backend & Settings Screen

![Current Settings Screen](data:image/jpeg;base64,)  
*File location: `docs/assets/barebones_screenshots/01_settings_screen_barebones.jpg`*

#### Critique of Current Screen:
* Looks like a raw developer debug menu with technical IP addresses, red timeout errors, and raw text input boxes.
* Too clinical and unintuitive for a normal user.

#### Redesign Wishlist:
* **Simplified Connection Status:**
  * Replace technical error stacks with a clean status dot: Green `Connected to Gemini Vision`, or Amber `Working Offline`.
* **Clean Network Presets:** Flat toggle pills for `Local Server`, `Cloud Backend`, or `Demo Mode`.
* **Storage & Stats:** A clean overview card showing total receipts saved, total spend recorded, and storage used.

## 5. Theming Options: High-Contrast Black & White and Extended Palettes

We want to give users multiple beautiful themes, including **bold, high-contrast monochrome (Black & White)** as well as clean modern color schemes. All themes must follow the rule: **No gradients, no glassmorphism.**

### Theme Option 1: Stark Editorial Monochrome (Pure Black & White)
* **Surface / Background:** Pure stark white (`#FFFFFF`) or off-white (`#F8F9FA`).
* **Text / Primary Elements:** Pitch solid black (`#000000`).
* **Borders & Dividers:** Crisp 1.5px solid black borders (`#000000`).
* **Accent & Highlights:** High-contrast inverse solid black fill with white text.
* **Vibe:** Ultra-clean, timeless, Swiss graphic design, brutalist-minimal, high legibility.

### Theme Option 2: Pitch Black OLED Dark Mode (High-Contrast Dark)
* **Surface / Background:** Pure true black (`#000000`) for OLED battery saving.
* **Card Surfaces:** Dark warm charcoal (`#141414`) with 1px border (`#262626`).
* **Text:** Crisp bright white (`#FFFFFF`) and secondary ash gray (`#A3A3A3`).
* **Accent:** Pure white pill buttons with black text, or sharp electric yellow (`#FACC15`) dot indicators.
* **Vibe:** Sleek, modern, stealthy, easy on the eyes at night.

### Theme Option 3: Modern Sage & Slate (Clean Daily)
* **Surface:** Crisp soft paper (`#F9FAF9`).
* **Card Fill:** Pure white (`#FFFFFF`) with soft gray outline (`#E5E7EB`).
* **Primary Accent:** Deep Forest Sage (`#1E4D38`).
* **Text:** Charcoal slate (`#111827`).
* **Vibe:** Fresh, organized, organic, calm.

### Theme Option 4: Contrast Navy & Safety Amber (Crisp Financial)
* **Surface:** Soft cool parchment (`#F4F6F8`).
* **Primary Accent:** Deep Midnight Navy (`#0F172A`).
* **Secondary Highlight:** Sharp Amber Yellow (`#F59E0B`).
* **Text:** Pitch Navy (`#0A0F1D`).
* **Vibe:** Trustworthy, sharp, energetic, modern fintech.

---

## 6. Micro-Interactions, Feedback Toasts & Subtle UI Elements

A great app feels responsive and thoughtful. We need mockups and designs for the subtle micro-elements:

### 6.1 Toast Notifications (Snackbars)
Design clean, flat, floating toast banners that appear at the top or bottom of the screen:
* **Success Toast:** Solid green dot + *"Receipt processed! 6 items added to Groceries."*
* **Error Toast:** Solid red dot + *"Connection timed out. Saved locally for offline sync."* + Flat `[Retry]` link.
* **Warning Toast:** Solid amber dot + *"2 items have low confidence. Check Review Queue."*
* **Info Toast:** Solid blue dot + *"Switched to Gemini Vision engine."*

### 6.2 Friendly Error & Empty States
* **No Red Error Code Dumps!** Replace technical errors with a clean card featuring:
  * A friendly icon (e.g. an unplugged cord or a thinking receipt character).
  * Clear everyday headline: *"Can't reach the server right now"*.
  * Actionable guidance: *"Check if you're on the same Wi-Fi, or switch to Offline Mode."*
  * Big, friendly `Retry Connection` button.

### 6.3 Loading & Skeleton Shimmers
* Replace infinite spinning circle loaders with **clean skeleton loading placeholders** (flat gray rectangular pills that mimic receipt cards and text lines).

## 7. Ready-to-Use Google Stitch Prompts

The UI/UX designer can copy and paste these exact prompts directly into Google Stitch:

### Stitch Prompt 1: Homescreen App Icon
```text
Design a modern, minimalist mobile application icon for "ReceiptLedger", an expense tracker for paper receipts.
Style: Playful, casual, friendly, approachably modern.
Visual motif: A clean, stylized paper receipt slip with a subtle smile fold or geometric notch.
Strict constraints: Completely flat vector, ZERO gradients, ZERO 3D glossy effects, solid colors only.
Palette: Crisp white background, solid deep black line art, and a single accent pop of warm amber or sage green.
Needs high contrast, instantly memorable on an iPhone or Android homescreen.
```

### Stitch Prompt 2: Secret Profile Drawer (Sidebar)
```text
Design a sleek, functional mobile slide-out drawer (sidebar) for a receipt ledger app.
Trigger: Slides out when tapping the circular profile avatar in the top app bar.
Contents:
- Top: Circular user photo, name "Asad Khan", email "user@receiptledger.com", and a small "Pro Ledger" tag.
- Menu items with clean outline icons: Profile Settings, Export Data (CSV/PDF), App Licenses & About.
- Theme Switcher: A clean 3-way flat pill switch for [Light | Dark | B&W].
- Bottom: Distinct Logout button with clean flat red outline.
Aesthetic: Minimalist, clean flat cards, zero gradients, zero glass blur.
```

### Stitch Prompt 3: High-Contrast Black & White Mobile Redesign
```text
Redesign a receipt scanner mobile application in high-contrast stark black and white aesthetic.
Inspired by minimalist Swiss editorial design and Japanese stationery.
Screens to show:
1. Receipt Capture View: Clean camera viewfinder with corner alignment marks, pill toggle for [Single | Batch], and a solid black shutter button.
2. Review Queue: A card displaying a cropped photo snippet of receipt text, paired with editable candidate text fields for item name and price, with solid black [Confirm] button and outline [Edit] button.
3. Floating Toast: A clean black pill banner showing "Receipt saved to ledger (PKR 2,400)".
Strict rules: 100% flat vector, zero gradients, zero shadows, zero liquid glass. Crisp 1.5px black borders.
```
